text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the 
 equipment inspection I1, which must be
 performed every three months intervals bases 
 as indicated by 
 M3 in the title block.
The aim of these instructions is to recommend a minimum 
 requirements for checks and inspections in order to maintain the reliability 
 of the fire fighting systems in the transformer yards.
The 
first draft initiated by Eng. Emad Farouq Moustafa at Katamia 220kv substation Cairo Zone.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued,
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Transformer outage is 
 required
After the functioning 
 test of the system, make sure
That the valve between 
 compressor and main tank is closed before refilling the tank again with water
Tools and Equipment
Safety Helmet, Safety Shoes, and breathing mask .
Work to be carried out
Carry out the weekly inspection steps as described at MPIS document number 
FS-009-r0
Carry out the weekly inspection steps as described at MPIS document number 
FS-009-r0
Check water level in main tank (up to red mark) for this, open shout - off 
 devices of water level indicator
Check excess pressure in tank, refill with water, if necessary pressure must 
 be between (9.5 : 10 bar) 
 * Start filling - 
 pump manually
 * Open shut - off 
 devices of water filling - line
Every three months (M3)
Test the single - chamber remote control valve (C):
 Close the main gate valve (B1) and the air filling valve (M) / relieve the 
 incitation pipe system by operating the solenoid valve (J). The valve disk 
 (C1) will unlock
Open hand - hole cover
Clean the sealing surface of the valve disk and seat by means of a saft rag
Place valve disk again on its seat
Loosen the adjusting screw (C2) about 1 turn and move the lever (C3) to the 
 right up to the stop (Its nose must then rest on the bridge of the valve 
 disk)
Open air filling valve (M) and fill the incitation pipe system with 
 compressed air
Slowly open the main gate valve (B1) fully and secure it in open position by 
 a padlock strap
Close hand hole cover
Open vent valve (E2) until water is discharging, then close it again
Yearly (Y1)
Carry out the above steps
Close main gate valve (B2), open and clean the strainer if a pressure tank or 
elevated tank is existing, clean the in side and repair the coat of paint, if 
necessary
Carry out the above steps
Close main gate valve (B2), open and clean the strainer if a pressure tank or 
elevated tank is existing, clean the in side and repair the coat of paint, if 
necessary
Two Years (Y2)
1- Carry out the three months inspection and the annually steps
2- Drain 
pressure tank, repair anti-corrosion protection inside and out side if 
necessary
